labels.catalog_intro: Labels define the state and behavior of your resources. Every resource always has at least one visibility label.
labels.desc_owner: You are the direct owner of this resource.
labels.desc_linked: The resource reached you via a group or share; the original owner is someone else.
labels.desc_agent: Configurable assistant with its own instructions, model and connection to chat or run tasks.
labels.desc_skill: Reusable knowledge block (prompt or instructions) that an agent can invoke.
labels.desc_prompt: Invocable prompt with @alias from chat, injected into the turn when the agent has it linked.
labels.desc_tool: Python/Shell script or precompiled C++ binary that gets cataloged and assigned to an agent. Phase 1: cataloging only, no execution yet.
labels.desc_knowledge: Skills, documents, links or memory used as a knowledge source for your agents.
labels.desc_connection: Credentials and settings to talk to a model provider (API key, endpoint).
labels.desc_memory: Persistent memory file an agent can read or write during a conversation.
labels.desc_workflow: Multi-agent sequence of steps run as an orchestration.
labels.desc_private: Only you can see and use this resource. It does not appear in any public listing.
labels.desc_public: The resource is visible to everyone in Explore and on your public profile.
labels.desc_production: Indicates this resource is in active use in a production environment.
labels.desc_staging: Pre-production environment. The resource is ready for final validation before going to production.
labels.desc_development: Resource under development or testing. Signals it may still change.
labels.desc_test: Resource reserved for testing and validation.
labels.desc_favorite: Marks the resource as a favorite for quick access.
labels.desc_draft: Work in progress, not ready to use. Blocks access until it is complete.
labels.desc_review: The resource needs review before being used or published.
labels.desc_deprecated: Still works but is obsolete. A more recent alternative is recommended.
labels.desc_quarantine: Blocks the resource. Cannot be used or start chats until the label is removed.
labels.desc_archived: Blocks the resource. Indicates it is no longer active. Can be kept for reference.
labels.desc_delete: Marks the resource for deletion. Blocks its use and allows bulk removal from the panel.
